NEW: resolving in this order permits the newly gained skill to be the Expertise choice. Expertise replaces PB with2PB only for that skill’s checks; it is not doubled again by another Expertise source and grants no tool expertise. A primary-trade tool grant initializes its actual trade at1/zeroXP; other tools do not invent trades.
